blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Local disaster officials have launched an intensive three-day contingency workshop here to fortify the preparedness of vulnerable communities surrounding Musuan Peak. The site is locally known as Mount Calayo or “Fire Mountain,” an active volcano located in Maramag, Bukidnon. The emergency preparedness initiative, held from November 16 to 18, involved high-risk barangays situated within the volcano’s danger zone. These places are Guinoyoran, Barobo, Catumbalon, Maapag, Pinatilan, Batangan, Lumbo and Poblacion. The areas represent a combined population of 87,092 residents, based on the 2024 census.
